errors.text: The material is misidentified as a refractory BCC/B2 HEA rather than the as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic FCC+B2 HEA.
The proposed transition is primarily aging-time-dependent, whereas the target transition is temperature-dependent, with embrittlement near 600 °C and recovery near 750 °C.
The structural mediator is assigned to B2 ordering and phase-fraction percolation rather than enhanced L12 ordering in FCC domains coupled to jagged FCC/B2 phase boundaries.
The cited evidence does not demonstrate a ductile-brittle-ductile transition, ordering evolution at 600–800 °C, or ductility recovery through B2 coarsening or BCC-network restoration.
